Frontend Engineer (React)
Brightpath Learning · Remote (US)

We're looking for a frontend engineer to help millions of students learn on our web platform. You'll join a cross-functional squad of designers, PMs and engineers.

Responsibilities:
* Build accessible, responsive user interfaces with React and TypeScript
* Turn Figma designs into reusable components in our Storybook design system
* Improve Core Web Vitals and overall web performance across our Next.js app
* Write unit and end-to-end tests with Jest, React Testing Library and Playwright
* Collaborate closely with designers and backend engineers on GraphQL API contracts

Qualifications:
* 3+ years building production web applications
* Expert knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS
* Hands-on experience with React and modern state management (Redux or Zustand)
* Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) and responsive design
* Comfortable with Git, code review and CI/CD workflows
* Strong attention to detail and clear communication

Bonus points:
* Experience with Tailwind CSS or styled-components
* Exposure to React Native
* Interest in education technology

What we offer
* Fully remote team, flexible hours
* Home office stipend
